A huge thank you to Léna for her warm welcome and helpful advice! I was looking for things to get my cat equipped, and she perfectly guided me to a super practical carrier and a pack of very effective absorbent mats. You can tell she really knows her stuff and cares about animal welfare. The customer service was top-notch, fast, and friendly. I'll definitely be back to this shop!

RUN AWAY -

EDIT (Reply to manager Yoann): That's not exactly how it happened, and I remind you of your insolent tone on the phone, constantly interrupting me. Not to mention his very businesslike "then stop ordering from us" during my numerous calls regarding the poor service they provide.

Thank you to the young woman I spoke to earlier at the store, who kindly explained that she would set aside a pack of wet food for me (they do have it in stock, it's baffling) and promised that I would pay the website price because the pack is much more expensive in-store!!

Lamentable. A disaster. Out of stock for months on basic products like Royal Canin. I had to switch to a different food to find a last-minute solution for my kitten, and now Hill's is out of stock with them, supposedly due to a "supplier issue"!!! They simply don't manage their stock properly. The website shows the products, then in the store they tell you they're out of stock… I still have €7 on my loyalty card, but of course I can't get it back unless I buy something in the store. The manager doesn't seem concerned about finding a solution for his customers. "We might get a delivery in a week, but it's not certain…" "I'm not going to call every customer to tell them there's a shortage." In short, RUN AWAY if you want to protect your pets. Other Animalis stores are also out of stock, so avoid them and choose another store from a different company!

EDIT 08/18/2026: After placing an order on their website to see if they were able to fulfill it this time (a last-ditch effort that didn't work out), the click and collect price has jumped to €3.49 (!!!) for a bag of kibble and a pack of wet food (a perfectly reasonable order). Order placed on 08/08. I received a text/email on August 12th to pick up my order. That same day, I stumbled upon an email in my spam folder informing me that my order had been refunded (no stock after all!!! "The website isn't regularly updated and doesn't communicate with the stores"—what a shame!!). However, I was NOT reimbursed for the click and collect fees. Beware of fake positive reviews that artificially inflate the store's rating!

I went in yesterday to book a grooming appointment for my dog. I was asked to come back the next day because the groomer would be there to take the appointment. So I returned this morning and asked to speak to her. They didn't even call her name; they just asked if I was already a client. I explained that it was my first time coming for grooming, and then they told me she wasn't taking any new clients. First of all, I would have appreciated being told this the day before to avoid wasting my time. Secondly, what's the point of reserving services only for existing clients and not new ones? And finally, Animalis only offers this service in two stores in Paris: one in the 3rd arrondissement, which is convenient for me, and the other in the 16th, which is practically on the other side of town. It's not like this service is available everywhere. In short, I'm a customer of yours since I have a loyalty card, but that doesn't entitle me to grooming for my dog. Well, you can count on me not to come to your place to spend my money anymore, since you don't want it anyway!

A catastrophic and outrageous experience. Animalis shows utter contempt for its customers. My order for an automatic litter box was placed over two weeks ago, paid for immediately, with an additional charge for delivery… and I still haven't received anything. Absolutely nothing.

Despite numerous calls, there's been no solution, no acceptance of responsibility, and no reliable delivery date. Just empty excuses and vague answers. This is shameful and unworthy of a company that claims to be professional.

Taking the money is quick, but following up afterward is clearly not their priority. You feel completely abandoned once the payment is made. This is a serious form of business negligence.

This is an essential product for animal hygiene, not an accessory. Making a customer wait over two weeks without clear information is unacceptable and disrespectful.

I strongly advise against ordering from Animalis online. Lack of seriousness, lack of transparency, lack of professionalism. A deplorable experience that I wouldn't wish on anyone.

This review concerns the online store.
I placed an order Tuesday morning after checking the website, which stated "delivery within 24 hours."

It's now Friday, and the order still hasn't been delivered, with no information or tracking available.

After contacting customer service, I was told that "delivery within 24 hours" only refers to shipping time, not the time between ordering and receiving the order.

I was also told that delivery is scheduled for next Tuesday or Wednesday, almost a week after placing the order.

This wording is ambiguous and could mislead the customer. When a website states "delivery within 24 hours," it's reasonable to understand that the order will be delivered the next day, not a week later.

I'm posting this review here because it seems to be the most effective way to report the problem and ensure it's addressed.
This doesn't reflect on the service in the store, which is always pleasant, but this issue deserved to be brought to my attention.

The wheeled backpack I bought was too small for my cat (who is quite large) and didn't have enough room to lie down comfortably. My biggest complaint is that the wheels dig into the back when the bag is worn as a backpack. The bottom of the bag isn't supportive enough (there's a removable system, but it weakens the whole thing). When the bag is pulled along by the wheels, it feels very close to the ground.
